name: dexe-mcp

tools.name: dexe_dao_predict_addresses
tools.description: Read-only. Calls `PoolFactory.predictGovAddresses(deployer, poolName)` — the six CREATE2-predicted contract addresses for a DAO before it is deployed.

deployer.description: Address that will send the deployGovPool tx (tx.origin)

poolName.description: Unique pool name — part of the CREATE2 salt

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_dao_registry_lookup
tools.description: Read-only. Calls `PoolRegistry.isGovPool(address)` — true when the address is a registered DeXe DAO GovPool.

govPool.description: Alias for `address` — the name every other DAO tool uses

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_dao_info
tools.description: Read-only. One multicall on a GovPool: helper addresses, NFT contract addresses, description URL, and live validator count.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_proposal_state
tools.description: Read-only. Reads `getProposalState`, `getProposalRequiredQuorum` and the proposal's votes in one multicall. `requiredQuorum` is an ABSOLUTE vote weight, not a percentage; quorum is per-side — either For or Against clearing it reaches quorum.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_proposal_list
tools.description: Read-only. Calls `GovPool.getProposals(offset, limit)` and adds quorum progress per proposal. Quorum is per-side — either For or Against clearing the target reaches it; `requiredQuorum` is an ABSOLUTE vote weight, not a percentage.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_vote_user_power
tools.description: Read-only. Reads `tokenBalance` and `nftBalance` on GovUserKeeper for every VoteType (Personal/Micropool/Delegated/Treasury) in one multicall. tokenBalance includes the un-deposited wallet balance; deposited power = tokenBalance - tokenOwned.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_read_treasury
tools.description: Read-only. Treasury / wallet balances for any address; pass a GovPool address for a DAO treasury. Auto-discovers EVERY token via the DeXe backend with USD prices and a total. Falls back to an on-chain read (chain 97, explicit `tokens`, or a backend failure) — no token discovery there, and it reports `degraded: true`.

holder.description: Address whose balances we read (a GovPool for a DAO treasury)

govPool.description: Alias for `holder` — every other DAO read names the DAO this way

tokens.description: Optional explicit ERC20 addresses; forces on-chain RPC read of just these

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_read_token_holders
tools.description: Read-only. Holders + raw balances for any ERC20 from the DeXe backend, balance desc, one page per call (see `pageToken`). Mainnets only (1, 56).

chainId.description: Chain for the backend lookup: 1 Ethereum, 56 BSC. Testnets are not indexed. Default: the configured chain.

pageToken.description: Prior result's `nextPageToken` for the next page.

tools.name: dexe_read_dao_stats
tools.description: Read-only. Time series of DAO stats (tvl_usd, member counts, proposal counts, delegations) from the DeXe tracker. `period` is a human duration like '24 hours', '7 days', '1 months'. Backend-only — mainnets.

chainId.description: Chain for the backend lookup: 1 Ethereum, 56 BSC. Testnets are not indexed. Default: the configured chain.

period.description: Duration window, e.g. '24 hours', '7 days', '1 months'

maxPoints.description: Cap on returned data points; longer series are evenly downsampled (first and last points always kept). The tracker emits ~hourly points — '1 months' is ~740 raw points / ~650 KB, far beyond a usable context window.

tools.name: dexe_read_settings
tools.description: Read-only. Reads `GovSettings.getDefaultSettings()` and `getInternalSettings()` for the DAO at `govPool` — quorum, duration, executionDelay, minVotesForCreating/Voting.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_ipfs_upload_proposal_metadata
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Pins `{proposalName, proposalDescription}` to IPFS via Pinata; returns the CID for `descriptionURL` in `GovPool.createProposal`.

description.description: Proposal body; Markdown supported, converted to the Slate format the frontend expects.

extra.description: Extra fields merged into the metadata object.

tools.name: dexe_ipfs_upload_file
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Pins a file to IPFS; PREFER `filePath` over base64. Returns CID v1 (base32) + filename. Images are magic-byte gated to rasters and renamed `.jpeg` unless `normalizeImageExt: false`.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file, max 25 MB — the server reads it. Preferred over base64.

base64.description: Base64 file bytes — only when the content isn't a local file.

fileName.description: Filename to pin it under, with extension.

normalizeImageExt.description: If contentType starts with image/, rename the extension to .jpeg.

tools.name: dexe_ipfs_upload_avatar
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Pins an image, returning {avatarCID, avatarFileName, avatarUrl}. PREFER `filePath`; never pass base64 through the conversation. Magic-byte validated (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF only — SVG/HTML render broken on app.dexe.io); renamed `.jpeg`; CID v1 base32.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local image (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF, max 10 MB). Preferred over base64.

base64.description: Base64 image bytes — only when the image isn't a local file.

fileName.description: Base filename; extension will be normalized to .jpeg

contentType.description: Caller-claimed MIME type. Informational only — the pinned MIME comes from byte sniffing.

tools.name: dexe_dao_generate_avatar
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Renders a real JPEG of the DAO's initials over a hash-coloured gradient and pins it, returning {avatarCID, avatarFileName, avatarUrl}. Deterministic.

daoName.description: DAO name; first 1–2 alphanumeric chars become the avatar initials.

tools.name: dexe_ipfs_fetch
tools.description: Read-only. Fetches IPFS content via DEXE_IPFS_GATEWAY (dedicated; Pinata issues one with the JWT). Public gateways are opt-in via DEXE_IPFS_GATEWAYS_FALLBACK, tried after the primary.

tools.name: dexe_proposal_catalog
tools.description: Read-only, local. Every proposal type DeXe supports (external, internal validator, off-chain) with target, IPFS-metadata need, gating and builder tool.

category.description: Restrict to one category; 'all' returns the whole catalog.

implementedOnly.description: True to list only types that have an MCP builder.

tools.name: dexe_vote_build_erc20_approve
tools.description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `ERC20.approve(spender, amount)`. Run it before dexe_vote_build_deposit when staking an ERC20: approve the DAO's GovUserKeeper (dexe_dao_info), never the GovPool. Native-coin staking needs no approve — pass `value` on deposit instead.

token.description: ERC20 token contract address to approve.

spender.description: For deposits: the DAO's GovUserKeeper address (NOT the GovPool)

amount.description: Allowance in the ERC20 at `token`, that token's own decimals. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create. Unlimited = max uint256, i.e. '115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935'

govPool.description: DAO GovPool. When set, an approve to it (instead of its GovUserKeeper) is refused.

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_vote_build_deposit
tools.description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `GovPool.deposit(amount, nftIds)` — stakes into the DAO to gain voting power. Payable: native-coin DAOs pass `value`; ERC20 DAOs pass value=0 and need the GovUserKeeper approve first.

amount.description: Governance token to stake, in that token's own decimals. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create

nftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

value.description: Native coin (BNB/ETH, 18 decimals) sent with the tx — native-staking DAOs only. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create. Pass '0' for ERC20-staking DAOs

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_vote_build_withdraw
tools.description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `GovPool.withdraw(receiver, amount, nftIds)` — unstakes deposited governance tokens. Tokens you voted with stay locked until that proposal is executed.

receiver.description: Address the unstaked tokens/NFTs are sent to.

amount.description: Governance token to unstake, in that token's own decimals. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create

nftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_vote_build_vote
tools.description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. Emits `GovPool.multicall([vote(proposalId, isVoteFor, amount, nftIds)])` — the single-element multicall the frontend sends, because SphereX-protected pools revert a raw top-level vote(). Needs staked or delegated power first (dexe_vote_build_deposit).

isVoteFor.description: true = vote FOR, false = vote AGAINST.

amount.description: Your staked/delegated governance token power to cast, that token's own decimals. RAW base units, digits only ('1500000000000000000' = 1.5 at 18 dec); '1.5' is REJECTED — scale it, or use dexe_proposal_create

nftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

voter.description: Your address. When set, the deposit-lock warning is checked against your live power and shown only if your tokens really are locked.

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_vote_build_execute
tools.description: Builds calldata; does not broadcast. `GovPool.execute(proposalId)`; scope:'internal' + govValidators builds `GovValidators.executeInternalProposal(proposalId)` (anyone may send once Succeeded). When an action calls GovSettings.addSettings the response carries an advisory naming the chains where the proposal passes the vote and then reverts here — read it before signing.

scope.description: 'external' executes on GovPool; 'internal' on GovValidators (needs govValidators).

voter.description: Your address. When set, the deposit-lock warning is checked against your live power and shown only if your tokens really are locked.

chainId.description: Chain this payload targets: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_dao_report
tools.description: Read-only. The whole picture of one DAO in one call — every section named by `sections` (default all), plus everything with a DEADLINE: open votes, executable proposals and, with `user`, unvoted proposals and claimable rewards. Pass `since` (ISO timestamp, Unix seconds, `block:<n>`, or `last`) for ONLY what changed; each run stores a snapshot so the next `since` diff has a baseline. Sections degrade independently; unavailable ones are NAMED in `unavailable[]` with the reason.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

since.description: Diff anchor: ISO-8601 ('2026-08-01T00:00:00Z'), Unix seconds ('1785000000' / 'unix:…'), a block number ('block:62000000'; a bare integer below 1e9 is read as a block), or 'last' to diff against this DAO's previous report run. Omit for a full point-in-time report.

sections.description: Narrow the report. Default: all of identity, settings, treasury, membership, delegation, experts, validators, proposals, turnout, activity, deadlines.

user.description: Optional wallet. Adds per-user deadline items: proposals in Voting this user has NOT voted on, and claimable rewards.

proposalLimit.description: How many of the NEWEST proposals to walk for state, outcomes and turnout.

memberLimit.description: Member/delegation rows to fetch (newest joiners first).

persist.description: Store this run's snapshot so a later `since` diff has a baseline. Full runs only — a `sections`-narrowed run never overwrites it.

tools.name: dexe_read_dao_list
tools.description: Read-only. Paginated DAO discovery via the pools subgraph; name search is case-insensitive, ordered by voter count descending. Pass `chainId` (chains with a pools endpoint here: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows. No endpoint for a chain = an error; read it on-chain with dexe_read_multicall (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,read) or dexe_read_gov_state (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,dev).

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_read_dao_members
tools.description: Read-only. Paginated member list for a DAO — voting power, delegation counts, rewards, expert status. Pass `chainId` (chains with a pools endpoint here: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows. No endpoint for a chain = an error; read it on-chain with dexe_read_multicall (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,read) or dexe_read_gov_state (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,dev).

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_read_delegation_map
tools.description: Read-only. Delegation pairs from the pools subgraph: direction='outgoing' = who a user delegated to, 'incoming' = who delegated to them. Pass `chainId` (chains with a pools endpoint here: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows. No endpoint for a chain = an error; read it on-chain with dexe_read_multicall (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,read) or dexe_read_gov_state (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,dev).

addresses.description: Voter WALLET addresses (plain 0x…40-hex). Composite VoterInPool ids ('govPool-voter' or 80-hex 'voter+pool' concatenations) are also accepted — the voter part is extracted automatically.

direction.description: outgoing = who I delegated to; incoming = who delegated to me

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_otc_list_sales_for_dao
tools.description: Read-only. Reads `latestTierId()` then `getTierViews(0, latestTierId)` on the DAO's TokenSaleProposal: tiers with `totalSold` and status (`upcoming`/`active`/`ended`/`off`) computed from the current block timestamp and the tier's on-chain isOff flag. On-chain only — any chain with an RPC; the reply echoes the resolved `chainId`. `tokenSaleProposal` defaults to the one recorded when this install deployed the DAO; otherwise it is required.

tokenSaleProposal.description: TokenSaleProposal helper address. Omit for a DAO this install deployed; otherwise dexe_dao_predict_addresses or the deploy receipt.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_graph_query
tools.description: Read-only. GraphQL against a DeXe subgraph: 'pools' (DAOs, proposals, voters, delegations, experts, sales), 'interactions' (per-user tx feed), 'validators'. Bound every list with `first:` (max 1000), page with `skip:`; oversized responses are rejected. NEVER guess a name — call dexe_graph_schema; root fields are not entity names (DaoPool -> `daoPools`). `chainId` picks the endpoint (pools: 56, validators: 56, interactions: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows.

variables.description: GraphQL variables referenced by the query

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_graph_schema
tools.description: Read-only. Live introspection of a DeXe subgraph schema — the recovery path when dexe_graph_query answers "Type 'X' has no field 'Y'". Omit `entity` for the root query field map (each entity -> the field name to query it by); pass `entity` for that type's fields, '<Entity>_filter' for valid `where:` keys, '<Entity>_orderBy' for valid `orderBy:` values. An unknown name returns ranked candidates. `chainId` picks the endpoint (pools: 56, validators: 56, interactions: 56; default 56); the reply echoes `indexedChainId`, never another chain's rows.

entity.description: Type name to expand, e.g. 'Proposal', 'VoterInPool', 'DaoPool_filter', 'Proposal_orderBy'. Omit for the root query field map.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tools.name: dexe_tx_send
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Sends the TxPayload fields from any dexe_*_build_* tool and waits for confirmation. Pass `chainId` when several chains are configured, plus the payload's own chainId as `payloadChainId` — a mismatch REFUSES the send. Calldata with a privileged GovUserKeeper accounting selector is refused (hard block, no override).

to.description: Destination contract address (or pass the builder's `payload` object)

value.description: Wei value as decimal string (the payload's `value`, default 0)

chainId.description: The payload's own chainId; used as payloadChainId

payload.description: A dexe_*_build_* `payload` object verbatim ({to,data,value,chainId}). Fills to/data/value and payloadChainId when the flat fields are omitted.

chainId.description: Chain to broadcast on; needs an RPC for it. Default: the MCP's default chain.

payloadChainId.description: The TxPayload's own `chainId`, copied verbatim — a mismatch REFUSES the send.

signerKey.description: Signer: omit = primary DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY (never an agent); 'agent<n>'/address = keyring.

tools.name: dexe_tx_status
tools.description: Read-only. Receipt/status for a submitted tx hash (pending vs not_found). A broadcast timeout is not a failure — the tx may still confirm; re-check here.

chainId.description: Chain to look the receipt up on. Default: the MCP's default chain.

tools.name: dexe_get_config
tools.description: Read-only, local. The MCP's chain set, default chain, and signer status.

tools.name: dexe_doctor
tools.description: Read-only. Diagnoses env setup: presence + reachability checks (RPC, Pinata, IPFS gateway DNS, subgraph, backend) as pass/warn/fail with remediation hints. Call FIRST on an env-related failure. Warnings are advisories — a healthy zero-config install always has some. `probePin` is the one write: one tiny IPFS pin.

probePin.description: Probe pin to Pinata (added, then removed) — use when an IPFS upload fails with HTTP 403.

tools.name: dexe_wc_status
tools.description: Read-only. WalletConnect config plus live session state (connected?, account, chain, topic, peer wallet, last error). Active only when DEXE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID is set AND no DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY is present.

chainId.description: Unused; reserved.

tools.name: dexe_wc_connect
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Starts a WalletConnect session and renders a scannable QR (ASCII + PNG). RECOMMENDED signer — the phone signs and broadcasts, so no private key touches this machine. Poll dexe_wc_status until `connected`. A hot DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY keeps signing precedence.

chainId.description: Chain to request in the session namespace. Defaults to the MCP's default chain.

tools.name: dexe_wc_disconnect
tools.description: Writes to a remote service. Tears down the active WalletConnect session; safe when not connected.

tools.name: dexe_proposal_create
tools.description:
Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Creates ANY governance proposal in ONE call: runs approve→deposit→createProposalAndVote and uploads correct IPFS metadata (category/isMeta/changes). Without a signer it returns ordered TxPayloads + a WalletConnect QR.
Pass `proposalType` — the enum lists every wired type — with its inputs in `params`:
• 'custom': your own actionsOnFor [{executor,value,data}]. 'modify_dao_profile' reads the top-level newDaoName/newDaoDescription/newWebsiteUrl/newSocialLinks/newAvatarPath fields, not `params`.
• External: token_transfer {token,recipient,amount,isNative?} · withdraw_treasury {receiver,token?,amount?,nftAddress?,nftIds?} · change_voting_settings {govSettings?,settings[],settingsIds?} · add_expert/remove_expert {expertNftContract,scope,nominatedUser,uri?} · token_sale_whitelist {tokenSaleProposal,requests[]} · token_sale_recover {tokenSaleProposal,tierIds[]} · manage_validators {govValidators,changes[]} · validators_allocation {credits[]} · delegate_to_expert/revoke_from_expert {expert,amount,nftIds?} · change_math_model {newVotePower} · blacklist {erc20Gov,addAddresses?,removeAddresses?} · apply_to_dao {token,receiver,amount} · new_proposal_type/enable_staking {govSettings?,settings,executors,newSettingId} · custom_abi {target,signature,method,args?} · token_distribution · token_sale · create_staking_tier · reward_multiplier.
• Internal (validators-only): change_validator_balances {changes[]} · change_validator_settings {duration,executionDelay,quorum} · monthly_withdraw {withdrawals[],destination} · offchain_internal_proposal {}.
Off-chain backend types are rejected with the flow to use instead. Full recipes with examples: dexe://playbook, or dexe_proposal_catalog.

chainId.description: Target chain (56 mainnet, 97 testnet); needs an RPC for it. Default: the MCP's default chain.

proposalType.description: What kind of proposal to create — required in practice. 'custom' means you supply actionsOnFor. Unsure? Call dexe_proposal_catalog.

params.description: Type-specific builder inputs for the chosen proposalType (recipes: tool description / dexe://playbook).

newDaoName.description: modify_dao_profile: the DAO's new display name.

newWebsiteUrl.description: modify_dao_profile: the DAO's new website URL.

newAvatarCID.description: modify_dao_profile: IPFS CID of an already-pinned avatar.

newAvatarFileName.description: modify_dao_profile: file name stored with newAvatarCID.

newAvatarPath.description: Local avatar image path (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF, max 10 MB) — the server validates and pins it for you.

newAvatarBase64.description: Base64 image bytes — only when the image isn't a local file.

value.description: Native coin sent with the action, RAW base units (wei).

actionsOnFor.description: Actions run when the proposal passes. Required for proposalType:'custom'.

proposalMetadataExtra.description: Extra fields merged into IPFS metadata.

voteAmount.description: Auto-vote amount: raw wei (digits only) or human units with a decimal point ('12.5'). Default: all available power.

voteNftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

user.description: User address. Required when DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY not set.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

dryRun.description: Preview: no broadcast, no IPFS pin, no Pinata key needed. The metadata CID is right but unpinned — do NOT broadcast this calldata.

confirmRisky.description: Required when the built proposal carries a DANGER governance-safety advisory. Without it the flow refuses BEFORE any transaction.

allowDuplicate.description: The create is SKIPPED when a live proposal already carries the same IPFS metadata URL (a resumed run). True mints a second identical proposal on purpose.

flowContext.description: Guided-flow position from dexe_guide's step templates. Adds flowProgress + next to the result and persists it.

tools.name: dexe_proposal_vote_and_execute
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. The ONE call for 'vote on / pass / execute proposal N': checks proposal state, AUTO-DEPOSITS wallet tokens when voting power is short (approve UserKeeper → deposit → vote, the frontend's bundled shape), and with autoExecute executes once the vote passes. Without a signer it returns ordered TxPayloads + a WalletConnect QR. Unsure of the lifecycle (validator round, locked tokens)? Call dexe_guide (flow:'vote_execute') first.

chainId.description: Target chain (56 mainnet, 97 testnet); needs an RPC for it. Default: the MCP's default chain.

voteAmount.description: Vote amount: raw wei (digits only) or human units with a decimal point ('12.5'). Default: ALL available power (deposited + wallet).

voteNftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

depositFirst.description: 'auto': deposit exactly what is missing when deposited power is short. true: deposit the whole wallet balance. false: never deposit.

autoExecute.description: Attempt execute if proposal passes after vote

driveValidatorRound.description: With autoExecute, drive the validator stage too: moveProposalToValidators, cast the signer's validator vote if it is one, then execute. False stops after the member vote.

dryRun.description: If true, return ordered TxPayloads even when DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY is set (preview without broadcasting).

user.description: User address. Required when DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY not set.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

flowContext.description: Guided-flow position from dexe_guide's step templates. Adds flowProgress + next to the result and persists it.

tools.name: dexe_dao_create
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Deploys a new DeXe DAO in ONE call. SIMPLE mode (recommended): pass `symbol` + `totalSupply` and the tool synthesizes a coherent, frontend-equivalent config (LINEAR power, treasury as an implicit remainder, a quorum that passes on realistic turnout). ADVANCED mode: pass a full `params` struct. Returns a `preview` of the resolved config + a safety proof and broadcasts only with `confirm: true`. Runs the frontend's governance coherence guards over ALL FIVE settings slots (default / internal / validators / distribution / tokenSale) — one un-passable slot bricks that whole proposal class forever — plus a calldata round-trip self-check and a pre-sign eth_call: a provable revert is refused with a classified cause + fix BEFORE any gas is spent, while an RPC outage only downgrades to a warning. Mainnet (56) always needs `confirm: true` (real BNB); validate on testnet (97) first. `deployer` defaults to the signer. Unsure of the journey or params? Call dexe_guide (flow:'create_dao').

chainId.description: Target chain id. Defaults to the MCP's default chain. Use 97 (BSC testnet) to validate; 56 = BSC mainnet (real funds).

poolFactory.description: PoolFactory override; defaults to ContractsRegistry lookup

deployer.description: tx.origin that sends the deploy (needed for address prediction). Defaults to the signer address.

daoName.description: DAO name (also the deployGovPool pool name)

daoDescription.description: DAO description (markdown; uploaded to IPFS as slate)

websiteUrl.description: DAO website URL shown on its profile.

name.description: Link label shown on the DAO profile.

documents.description: External documents shown on the DAO profile, e.g. [{ name: "Whitepaper", url: "https://..." }]

avatarCID.description: IPFS CID of an already-pinned JPEG avatar (dexe_ipfs_upload_avatar)

avatarPath.description: Local avatar image path (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF ≤10 MB) — server validates + pins it. Preferred over avatarCID.

symbol.description: SIMPLE mode: gov token symbol (e.g. 'GENA'). Required when `params` is omitted.

totalSupply.description: SIMPLE mode: total token supply in WHOLE tokens (e.g. '1000000'). Required when `params` is omitted.

treasuryPercent.description: SIMPLE mode: treasury share, percent 0-100 (implicit remainder; it cannot vote). Omit and the tool picks one that leaves a real voting margin (default 30).

quorumPercent.description: SIMPLE mode: quorum, percent 0-100. Omit and the tool picks (default 51). Must be >=50 and clearable by at most 80% turnout — a quorum equal to the votable share freezes the DAO forever.

voteModel.description: SIMPLE mode: vote-power model. LINEAR = 1 token = 1 vote (default). POLYNOMIAL = meritocratic curve.

durationSeconds.description: SIMPLE mode: voting duration. Default 86400 (1 day).

executionDelaySeconds.description: SIMPLE mode: delay before execution. Default 0.

minVotesTokens.description: SIMPLE mode: min tokens to vote AND create proposals, WHOLE tokens. Default '1'. Must be ≤ the largest holder's allocation.

address.description: Wallet receiving this slice of the supply.

recipients.description: SIMPLE mode: split the votable share across wallets (default: deployer only). Percents are of TOTAL supply and must sum to 100 − treasuryPercent.

earlyCompletion.description: SIMPLE mode: end voting as soon as the quorum is reached. Default true.

params.description: ADVANCED mode: the full deployGovPool params struct. Prefer SIMPLE mode. Field-by-field schema: dexe_dao_build_deploy (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,dev).

confirmRisky.description: Proceed despite a governance-safety refusal. Read the returned `risks` to the user FIRST — such a config cannot be repaired after deploy, because repairing it needs a proposal passed under it. Ignored when DEXE_TREASURY_GUARD=block.

confirm.description: True to actually broadcast; without it SIMPLE mode and any mainnet deploy return a review-only preview. Pass it on the FIRST call when the user has already approved the deploy.

dryRun.description: Preview: no broadcast, no IPFS pin, no Pinata key needed. CIDs are right but unpinned — do NOT broadcast this calldata.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

flowContext.description: Guided-flow position from dexe_guide's step templates. Adds flowProgress + next to the result and persists it.

tools.name: dexe_context
tools.description: Read-only. Session orientation — the signer address + mode, configured chains, env readiness (RPC/IPFS/subgraph/signer), which toolsets are on or hidden and what the hidden ones unlock, your deposited power in the newest DAO, and the agent KEYRING (signerKey, address, gas, 24h broadcasts per persona). Skip it when the user already named the DAO and chain. Persisted DAOs/proposals are WINDOWED; the *Total fields carry real counts.

includeDepositedPower.description: Read deposited power for the newest DAO (one extra RPC call).

includeAgentBalances.description: Probe each persona's native balance (one eth_getBalance per signer, default chain).

daoLimit.description: Recorded DAOs to return, newest first.

proposalLimit.description: Recorded proposals to return, newest first.

tools.name: dexe_guide
tools.description: Read-only, local. Call this FIRST for any multi-step or unfamiliar DeXe request — 'create a DAO', 'launch a token with distribution/OTC/staking', 'open a sale', 'pass this proposal'. Returns the ordered plan (which tools, in what order, with what params), the questions to ask the user with per-parameter risk notes, and the known pitfalls for that journey. Never improvise a governance flow without it. Reference topics answer data questions the same way (flow:"read_dao_data" covers the whole read surface). No args or a free-text `intent` returns the menu; `flow` returns the full plan.

intent.description: The user's request in free text — matched against the flow triggers (e.g. 'create a token and sell 20% via OTC').

flow.description: Exact flow or topic id. Takes precedence over `intent`; omit both for the menu.

chainId.description: Target chain (56 mainnet / 97 testnet). Defaults to the last-used, then the configured default chain.

tools.name: dexe_otc_dao_open_sale
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Proposes a multi-tier token sale on an OTC DAO: builds the `createTiers` envelope (deduped approves, auto-merkle, auto-addToWhitelist, merkle lists pinned to IPFS so buyers can regenerate proofs), then runs the proposal_create flow (approve, deposit, IPFS metadata, `createProposalAndVote`). DAOs from `dexe_dao_create` (v0.19+) already wire TokenSaleProposal as an executor; older ones need a `new_proposal_type` proposal first.

chainId.description: Target chain id. Defaults to the MCP's default chain.

tokenSaleProposal.description: TokenSaleProposal helper address. Omit for a DAO this install deployed (recorded at deploy); otherwise dexe_dao_predict_addresses or the deploy receipt.

totalTokenProvided.description: Sale tokens funding this tier, RAW base units (wei).

claimLockDuration.description: Lock after purchase before claiming, seconds.

saleTokenAddress.description: Token being sold (the DAO's token contract).

purchaseTokenAddresses.description: Tokens buyers may pay with; parallel to exchangeRates/purchaseRatios.

exchangeRates.description: Raw 25-precision rate wei: saleAmount = purchaseAmount * 1e25 / rate. "0.10 paid per 1 sold" = "1000000000000000000000000". Prefer `purchaseRatios`.

purchaseRatios.description: Human ratio of purchase tokens per 1 sale token ("0.10" = 0.10 USDT buys 1 HELIO); scaled to 1e25. Excludes `exchangeRates`.

minAllocationPerUser.description: Minimum sale tokens one buyer may take, RAW base units (wei); 0 = no floor.

maxAllocationPerUser.description: Maximum sale tokens one buyer may take, RAW base units (wei); 0 = no cap.

vestingPercentage.description: Share of the buy that vests, 25-decimal percent (1e25 = 1%); 0 = none.

cliffPeriod.description: Delay before the first unlock, seconds.

vestingSettings.description: Vesting of the purchased tokens; all zeros = none.

requiredVotes.description: Minimum DAO voting power, RAW base units (wei).

uri.description: Optional metadata URI for the whitelist.

token.description: ERC20 contract the buyer must lock.

amount.description: Amount to lock, RAW base units (wei).

nft.description: ERC721 contract the buyer must lock.

amount.description: Number of NFTs to lock, whole tokens.

users.description: Addresses the merkle root is built from.

uri.description: Optional metadata URI for the whitelist.

root.description: Optional pre-computed merkle root. If omitted but `users` is set, the tool computes it.

participation.description: Participation requirements, ANDed on-chain. Empty = an open tier.

tiers.description: Tier specs for `createTiers`, in order; at least one.

latestTierId.description: Current `latestTierId()` on the sale; new tiers start after it.

proposalName.description: Proposal title in the DAO UI.

voteAmount.description: Vote size: whole tokens ('12.5') or raw wei. Omit to vote with all available power.

voteNftIds.description: Your governance NFT token ids, decimal; [] for ERC20-only DAOs.

user.description: Acting address; defaults to the configured signer.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

dryRun.description: Preview: no broadcast, no IPFS pin. CIDs are right but unpinned — do NOT broadcast.

buildOnly.description: Return only the envelope (actions + metadata + merkle roots); skips IPFS and DAO reads.

acknowledgeVestingBlocked.description: Refused by default: opt into vestingPercentage > 0; the vested leg is stranded (F15).

flowContext.description: Guided-flow position from dexe_guide's step templates. Adds flowProgress + next to the result and persists it.

tools.name: dexe_otc_buyer_status
tools.description: Read-only. Tier params + user state across N tiers: purchasable status, claimable amount, vesting withdrawable, lockup ETA, totalSold, merkle root. `whitelists` adds the user's proof, making `canParticipate` accurate for gated tiers.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tierIds.description: Tier ids to report on, decimal strings.

user.description: Buyer address to report state for.

tierId.description: Tier the whitelist belongs to, decimal string.

users.description: Whitelisted addresses, exactly as the merkle root was built.

whitelists.description: Optional per-tier whitelist (for MerkleWhitelist proof generation).

tools.name: dexe_otc_buyer_buy
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Preflights balance + allowance, adds an ERC20 approve when needed, then builds `TokenSaleProposal.buy(tierId, paymentToken, amount, proof)`. Native path (0x000...000) skips approve and sets `value`; `whitelistUsers` generates the proof.

chainId.description: Target chain id. Defaults to the MCP's default chain.

tierId.description: Tier to buy from, decimal string.

tokenToBuyWith.description: Payment token; native BNB = 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE (0x0 is an alias).

amount.description: Amount to spend: human units ('100.5'), or digits-only = 18-decimal-normalized.

proof.description: Merkle proof for a gated tier; [] when not gated.

user.description: Buyer address; defaults to the configured signer.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

dryRun.description: If true, return ordered TxPayloads even when DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

simulateFirst.description: eth_call-simulate buy() first; aborts with the revertReason if the sim fails.

tools.name: dexe_otc_buyer_claim_all
tools.description: Broadcasts when a signer is configured. Reads `getUserViews(user, tierIds)` and sends `claim` for tiers with `claimableAmount > 0`. Tiers whose only balance is the VESTED leg are reported under `vestingBlocked` and NOT sent — `vestingWithdraw` is refused by the pool's firewall (upstream defect F15); `includeVesting: true` tries anyway.

chainId.description: Target chain id. Defaults to the MCP's default chain.

tierIds.description: Tier ids to sweep, decimal strings.

user.description: Claimer address; defaults to the configured signer.

signerKey.description: Keyring signer: omit = primary key; 'agent<n>' or address = a DEXE_AGENT_PK_* key.

dryRun.description: If true, return ordered TxPayloads even when DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY is set.

includeVesting.description: Attempt `vestingWithdraw` too; it reverts on every current pool (upstream F15).

instructions: Tools for DeXe Protocol governance DAOs, plus dexe_gov_* (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,governor) — a generic surface for external OpenZeppelin/Compound Governor DAOs. For any MULTI-STEP request (create a DAO, launch a token economy, OTC sale, staking, distribution, pass a proposal) call dexe_guide FIRST — it returns the exact plan, the questions to ask the user with risk notes, and the known pitfalls. Call dexe_context first WHEN you need orientation (signer, active chain, env readiness, DAOs/proposals from prior sessions) — skip it when the user already gave you the target DAO and chain. Prefer the composite flow tools over hand-sequencing calldata: dexe_dao_create (deploy a DAO), dexe_proposal_create (ANY of the 33 catalog proposal types — pass proposalType + params), dexe_proposal_vote_and_execute (auto-deposits when power is short). Amounts on the composites and proposal builders accept raw wei (digits-only) or human units with a decimal point ('12.5'); dexe_vote_build_* take RAW base units only. Durations are seconds. For images (DAO avatars): pass a LOCAL FILE PATH (avatarPath / newAvatarPath / filePath) and the server reads, validates, and pins it — never read image files or pass base64 through the conversation. The composites handle approve→deposit→create sequencing, correct IPFS metadata, and the known deploy/proposal reverts; on partial failure they return the landed-steps ledger — fix the cause and re-run the same call. On re-run, ERC20.approve / GovPool.deposit / createProposalAndVote / GovPool.vote are re-derived from chain state and skipped; GovPool.execute and the validator round are NOT — and a receipt-wait TIMEOUT means the transaction was already broadcast, so check dexe_tx_status before any re-run and never re-send blindly. When depositing, ERC20.approve the UserKeeper, never GovPool. Validate DAO deploys on BSC testnet (chain 97). Contract introspection — dexe_compile, dexe_get_abi, dexe_get_source, dexe_list_contracts, dexe_find_selector (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,dev): run the compile step once per session before the reads. The tool surface is gated by DEXE_TOOLSETS (default 'core' — 44 tools: the composites plus the zero-config reporting reads). The ~30 single-purpose dexe_proposal_build_* (needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,proposals) builders are NOT in it, and you do not need them: dexe_proposal_create covers every on-chain catalog type. dexe_context reports which sets are off and what they unlock — check it BEFORE telling a user to edit DEXE_TOOLSETS. Full intent→call recipes + error→remedy table: docs/PLAYBOOK.md (shipped in the package). MCP resources: dexe://playbook (recipes + error remedies), dexe://graph-schema (subgraph entity reference for dexe_graph_query), dexe://tools (full tool catalog). Recipe skills ship with the package (dexe-agent-team, dexe-create-dao, dexe-create-proposal, dexe-otc, dexe-report, dexe-setup, dexe-staking, dexe-vote-execute); dexe-agent-team also needs DEXE_TOOLSETS=core,agents plus hot keys. Installed automatically with the Claude Code plugin (`/plugin install dexe@dexe-mcp`), or copy them standalone with `npx dexe-mcp skills`.
